doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Live recordings from the club
summary: Few recordings from the Showcase came out; the unreleased tapes will go to the Roosevelt archives.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: So have you... you know... recordings? Are there a fair amount of recordings that have come out of these many years of?
Well, I mean I went searching and it wasn’t - there’s nothing there that I could find as the definitive place to find it, or documentation there to find all the recordings.

There’s a few that are recorded live, but there are many more that were recorded live that have not come out. They’re still on tape, and I doubt I’ll ever get releases for them. So I’m going to donate them to the Roosevelt Archives. There’s stuff that you’ll never hear. I mean it’s... we did a few. I did some work for Chess Records in the sixties, one of my many jobs.
